classification.difficultyReason: Identify principal, decimal annual rate and years in supplied substitution templates, then use the supplied subtraction template for interest; repeated cases add no new decisions.

content.prompt: Give monetary answers to the nearest cent.

children.label: a

children.label: b
children.prompt: Calculate the future value of an investment of $\$34\,000$ compounded annually at 24% p.a. over 4 years.

children.label: c

children.label: d
